maddeler.e:
استكتبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْتَبُوا (istaktabū) /is.tak.ta.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَكْتَبَ (istaktaba)
# اُسْتُكْتِبُوا (ustuktibū) /us.tuk.ti.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْتَبَ (istaktaba)
# اِسْتَكْتِبُوا (istaktibū) /is.tak.ti.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْتَبَ (istaktaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
